bio: Jola takes its name from the charming duo behind this venture: Jonathan Wittenbrink, who delivers outstanding vegan cuisine, and Larissa Andres, who manages the service in the compact dining space with charm and aplomb. Seasonal and regional ingredients go into the creative surprise set menu, which features memorable dishes such as raviolo stuffed with aubergine ragout, served with courgette, lightly toasted pine nuts and a wonderfully intense tomato essence. Choose between wine and alcohol-free pairings. The setting is stylish and modern yet pleasingly laid back – the open kitchen certainly adds to that. A nice touch: The menu is printed on plantable seed paper – take it home and see what blooms!...
